description: Ply-parity x last-move unit without a clean tactical meaning. Late (odd ply 23-35, I am second player) it fires mostly when the opponent's last stone went high into column 0, often filling it, or onto the top or bottom of column 6. Early (even ply 4-10) it fires when the opponent just played column 1, 3 or 4 low and has no stones in columns 0, 5 or 6. Silent at early odd and late even plies.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changed move probabilities by <0.01 on 4 positions.
notes: Layer 0. Activation depends on the board plus last move and is nearly order-invariant (reorderings give identical values). Best dev F1 0.385 (P 0.39, R 0.38), sim share 0.22. Per-stone effects of 0.1-0.4 are spread across all columns and are non-additive, and they change sign with ply (opponent col-0 stones hurt early but help late). It looks like a mixture or random direction. Steering has no effect. Synthesis was a hill-climb with act, reaching 1.727 vs dev max 1.551.
